openings.claim: Rim-anchored stops with loose vertical capture might replace hatch friction with lateral bearing without increasing seal compression: four M4 bolts anchor two padded strip pairs to the rim alone; two remaining bolts stop opposing hatch edges. Upper strips overlap with slight vertical clearance. Withdraw both assemblies fully; cord retains assemblies and pads. Drill/cut only supplied strips.
openings.discriminator: Versus G0049:R1 pressure clamps, little-compression registration could show hatch approach/contact, movement <=1 mm and stationary marked anchors without observed 2 mm opposite-corner lift. Friction clamps could also pass; outcome success alone cannot distinguish paths. Stationary anchors plus contact-arrested movement supports bearing; anchor slip, absent contact or pressure-dependent retention defeats it. Final card must permit retention and timely reopening.
openings.probe: First verify separate rim anchoring, bolt-edge contact and vertical capture with available strips; reject incompatible geometry. Fabricate within 90 minutes; observe ten numbered closure/20 N pull cycles within 20 minutes, final closure with supplied 1 mm card at marked right contact. Record hatch/anchor displacement, stop contact, corner lift, reopening time and seal tears; check full aperture after withdrawal. Require <=1 mm position error after ten cycles, 20 N retention and one-technician reopening <=30 seconds, including disturbance except seal-contact continuity. Reject any outcome failure, permanent deformation, new visible seal tears or unrecoverable components. Preserve existing hatch/rim/seal: no fixture drilling, cutting, gluing or permanent deformation; no powered mechanism; open aperture unobstructed. Maximum two configurations/twelve closure-pull trials, including a disturbed trial per configuration.
openings.uncertainty: Indispensable rim profile, hatch-edge access and bolt clearance are unknown. Pad protection and strips/bolts/anchors carrying 20 N without bending/slipping are unproved. Two stops may inadequately constrain supplied pull direction/repeated placement. Clearance must accommodate final card while preventing escape; available 1 m cord must allow recovery outside opening within 30 seconds.

lineage.reason: Retains causal relation, rival, comparisons, support/defeat conditions, stopping/resource limits and uncertain declared fit; previous qualified lineage remains context.

decision: Run geometry/capacity probe only; deployment unsupported. Bearing transfers compression concerns to rim anchoring and stop geometry.
